newsitem.title: UK: UK's Clarke raises inheritance tax threshold.
newsitem.headline: UK's Clarke raises inheritance tax threshold.

text.p: Britain's Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke said Britain would increase the threshold for inheritance tax to 215,000 stg but would not be able to make any progress on cutting the tax rate this year.
Clarke said the raising of the threshold was "a further significant step towards abolishing inheritance tax."
"Last year, I made significant progress towards our commitment," Clarke said in his budget speech.
"In this budget I will build on that by raising the value of the inheritance tax threshold to 215,000 stg."
